Financial Analyst / Associate (REAL Directs)
jobs.description:
What it's about

In this position, you will join the Partners Group Real Estate Private Equity team in Milan, with responsibilities across all aspects of real estate investments, including investment underwriting, due diligence and transaction execution, ongoing asset management and divestitures. Your primary focus will be on Partners Group’s Southern European exposure in Spain, Italy and Portugal and you will report to Partners Group’s Head of Southern Europe.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Financial modeling of business plans, cash flows, debt structures, underlying drivers and resulting investment returns

- Supporting sourcing and fundraising activities, taking responsibility early on as part of a dynamic European Team

- In depth analysis of investment opportunities across real estate assets, portfolios, and companies in a variety of sectors across different geographies.

- Performing and selectively leading due diligence workstreams on prospective investments (e.g. financial, commercial, tax, technical etc.)

- Drafting of investment recommendation documents

- Conducting various other tasks related to reporting, monitoring, market research, internal requests and marketing efforts with current and potential investors

What we expect

- Enthusiasm, passion for real estate and high energy level. Ambition to make an impact across our Southern European portfolio, mainly comprised of residential, student housing, hospitality and logistics exposure.

- Top academic credentials from a leading university

- 2-4 years of work experience in private equity, M&A or strategy consulting

- Prior work experience in real estate private equity or investment banking

- Excellent financial modeling, analytical, interpersonal and written communication skills

- Substantial prior experience in financial modeling and in drafting investment proposals

- Superior organizational competence (planning, scheduling, coordinating and time management)

- Excellent teamwork skills within international settings

- Excellent language skills - proficiency in English, Italian and ideally Spanish

- A strong desire to learn and succeed, along with an impeccable work ethic and a professional demeanor

What we offer

Partners Group is a global financial institution that retains the culture, pace and agility of a start-up. As a growing firm, we are committed to attracting, developing and retaining the very best talent, by offering a workplace where results are truly recognized and rewarded.

We offer a fantastic opportunity for you to grow:

- Professional, international working environment

- Challenging, rewarding career within a growing company

- Collaborative environment, with on-the-job training and mentorship opportunities

- Competitive compensation package, including performance based annual bonus (65'000 EUR annual gross salary)

- Collective Bargaining Agreement applicable (Comercio e Terziaro), role classified as Impegiati

jobs.description:
What it's about

Partners Group is a global financial institution that retains the culture, pace and agility of a start-up. As a growing firm, we are committed to attracting, developing and retaining the very best talent, by offering a workplace where results are truly recognized and rewarded.

We are looking for a  Digital HR Specialist  to join our dynamic Digital HR team. In this role, you will help manage HR systems and support users across Partners Group globally. You will play a key role in enhancing operational efficiency, supporting business-critical HR initiatives, and ensuring the successful delivery of HR projects.

This role will support and continuously improve the organization’s HR technology and digital enablement landscape. The role acts as a subject matter expert across multiple HR systems, digital knowledge platforms, and emerging AI tools, ensuring stable operations, compliant configurations, effective knowledge sharing, and a strong employee experience.

Main Responsibilities

- Act as a subject matter expert in two or more  SAP SuccessFactors modules

- Provide first‑ and second‑level support, managing standard and complex HR cases, escalations, and service requests.

- Perform root cause analysis to resolve recurring issues and prevent future incidents.

- Ensure adherence to SLA response, resolution, and lifecycle targets and support service performance improvements.

- Assess, challenge, and translate functional and technical change requests into scalable and compliant solutions.

- Plan and coordinate system releases, upgrades, UAT, regression testing, and post‑release validation.

- Coordinate with IT teams and external vendors to manage integrations, enhancements, and defect resolution.

- Maintain system stability, security, data integrity, and compliance, including roles, permissions, authorizations, and audit controls.

- Create, review, and maintain documentation and knowledge assets, including user guides, SOPs, configuration workbooks, UAT scripts, KB articles, handover documents, audit narratives, and data dictionaries.

- Manage and maintain digital knowledge platforms, including Confluence and Sharepoint.

- Apply AI tools (Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT) to support HR operations, reporting, documentation, and knowledge discovery.

- Monitor case trends, ticket patterns, auto‑alerts, and service metrics to identify risks and improvement opportunities.

- Collaborate with HR, IT, Talent Acquisition, and global stakeholders, translating technical concepts into clear business language.

- Contribute to continuous improvement, digital innovation, and operational excellence initiatives.

What we expect

- Bachelor’s degree in  Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Technology, Data Analytics , or a related field preferred

- At least  5 years of relevant experience  in HRIS specifically in SuccessFactors modules (Employee Central, Recruiting, Onboarding, Performance & Goals, Comepnsatio, Reporting and Learning)

- Proven experience with  ServiceNow HR Service Delivery  is required, including hands-on expertise in HR case management, workflow configuration, knowledge articles, and employee service delivery processes

- At least one  SAP SuccessFactors certification  is required; additional HRIS or ServiceNow certifications are a strong advantage

- Strong customer-service mindset with a deep focus on employee experience, operational excellence, and continuous improvement

- Agile, proactive, and eager to learn new HR systems and obtain further certifications

- Strong written and verbal communication skills in  English

- Proficiency in  Microsoft Office applications , including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

- Flexibility to work alternative schedules or shifts, as needed

jobs.title: Compliance Officer (German speaker)
Associate, Private Credit
Associate, Private Credit
Summer Analyst Program 2027
jobs.description:
What it's about

Women are underrepresented in the private markets industry. Partners Group has created this Summer Analyst Program to reduce this gap, exclusively targeting talented female candidates across academic fields who are interested in exploring a career in private markets.

The Summer Analyst Program is a hands-on program designed to equip successful applicants with the financial, analytical, data, and technology-enabled skills required to succeed in private markets investing.

Participants will learn how investment professionals combine commercial judgement, financial analysis, industry research, data, and digital tools to assess markets and investment opportunities. Successful completion of the Program could lead to the offer of a position in our full-time Financial Analyst Program.

.newspaper {

h1 {
font-size: 250%;
font-family: Lato;
}

h2 {
font-size: 200%;
}

p {
font-size: 100%;
}

What we expect

- Outstanding academic credentials : The Program is open to penultimate and final year undergraduate and graduate level students. We accept candidates from any field of study, including engineering, computer science, mathematics, natural sciences, business, law, humanities and social sciences. Candidates should be able to explain how their academic background and interests can contribute to private markets investing

- Strong analytical thinking and intellectual curiosity : Investing in private markets requires professionals who enjoy mastering new skills and solving problems in a high-pressure environment

- Data literacy and structured problem solving: Candidates should be comfortable working with data, assessing its quality, identifying patterns, and presenting conclusions

- Data and AI fluency: Candidates must be able to use digital and AI tools. We value critical thinking, awareness of limitations, and responsible judgement. Candidates should be able to demonstrate how they use technology to improve the quality, efficiency, and structure of their work

- Interest in technology-enabled ways of working: Candidates should be curious about how AI is influencing investment processes and financial markets. Exposure and/or experience with coding, data visualization, statistical analysis and/or workflow automation is expected

- Excellent communication and collaboration: Candidates must be able to explain complex ideas in simple language, write clearly, listen actively, and work effectively with colleagues from different professional and academic backgrounds

- Energy and passion : Candidates must have an ownership mindset, strong work ethic, and maintain high standards while contributing to the team

- Our business language is English : Additional languages are highly valued but not required

What we offer

- Comprehensive private markets investment training with the potential for a permanent position with the firm:  Participants will gain exposure to live investment opportunities and be considered for full-time employment after the conclusion of the program.

- On-the-job exposure across a wide range of industries, geographies and live transaction situations: Program participants will spend the summer in one of our investment teams (private equity – health & life, goods & products, services, technology and partnership – real estate, infrastructure or royalties) where they will gain exposure to all the stages of a private markets transactions, from investment sourcing, assessment, and due diligence to closing and managing portfolio assets.

- Independent investment project: Over the course of the summer, each participant will develop an investment opportunity that they will propose to their team. This provides exposure to all aspects of investment analysis. Previous proposals have progressed to be actively pursued investment opportunities.

- Mentorship: Mentorship from experienced investment professionals and continuous exposure to senior members of the firm through the course of training and business activities .

Application specifics:

- 9-week program  with expected  start date Wednesday, 16th of June 2027

- Application deadline is  30th of October 2026 (rolling review)

- Please apply at  www.partnersgroup.com  under the  Careers section

- Please include  a resume in English

- Please note that we may only accept applications from  candidates who are eligible to work full-time in Switzerland  (typically Swiss and EU nationals, or individuals undergoing education in Switzerland). Partners Group does not sponsor work visas for Switzerland.

Please note: Candidates from all genders are invited to apply for a direct position with Partners Group.

www.partnersgroup.com
